back pain.caution: Stop and seek advice if movement causes numbness, weakness, or severe pain.
back pain.description: Short, gentle walks and regular position changes, rather than staying in bed all day.
back pain.name: Gentle movement

back pain.caution: Keep it warm, not hot, and check your skin regularly.
back pain.description: A warm compress on the sore area can feel comforting for short periods.
back pain.name: Warm compress

blocked nose.caution: Use clean water as directed on the product.
blocked nose.description: Saline spray or rinse can help a blocked nose feel clearer. Follow the product instructions.
blocked nose.name: Saline spray

blocked nose.caution: Keep water at a comfortable temperature.
blocked nose.description: Steam from a warm shower can help you breathe more comfortably for a short time.
blocked nose.name: Warm shower steam

cold.description: Drink fluids as appropriate and rest. Warm drinks can feel soothing.
cold.name: Drink fluids

cold.caution: Use clean water as directed on the product, and do not share nasal devices.
cold.description: Saline spray or rinse can help a blocked nose feel clearer. Follow the product instructions.
cold.name: Saline nasal spray

cold.description: Rest and avoid spreading the cold to others where possible.
cold.name: Rest

headache.caution: If you have a condition that limits fluids, follow your clinician's advice.
headache.description: Drink fluids as appropriate, especially if you may be dehydrated. Sip regularly rather than all at once.
headache.name: Drink water

headache.description: Lie down in a dark, quiet room and rest your eyes. Avoid bright light and loud noise for a while.
headache.name: Rest in a dark, quiet room

headache.caution: Do not apply ice directly to skin for long periods.
headache.description: Place a cold compress or wrapped ice pack on your forehead for short periods, with a cloth between the pack and your skin.
headache.name: Cold compress

headache.caution: Keep the compress warm, not hot, and check your skin regularly.
headache.description: A warm compress or warm shower can help relax tense neck and shoulder muscles.
headache.name: Warm compress on neck and shoulders

headache.caution: Ginger can interact with blood thinners and may upset the stomach. Ask a pharmacist if you take blood thinners.
headache.description: A warm cup of ginger tea is a traditional comfort drink. It is a comfort measure, not a treatment.
headache.name: Ginger tea

headache.caution: Turmeric can interact with blood thinners and may upset the stomach or affect gallbladder conditions. Ask a pharmacist if you take blood thinners or have stomach or gallbladder problems.
headache.description: Warm milk or water with turmeric is a traditional comfort drink. Evidence for headache relief is limited, and it is a comfort measure, not a treatment.
headache.name: Turmeric milk / turmeric water

headache.caution: Stop if a stretch causes sharp pain, numbness, or dizziness, and seek advice.
headache.description: Slow, gentle neck and shoulder stretches, without forcing any movement that hurts.
headache.name: Gentle neck stretches

headache.description: Take a break from screens, bright light, and strong smells or perfumes until you feel better.
headache.name: Avoid screens and strong smells

sore throat.caution: Do not give honey to children under 1 year old.
sore throat.description: Warm tea with honey can soothe a sore throat. It is a comfort measure, not a medicine.
sore throat.name: Warm tea with honey

sore throat.caution: Do not swallow large amounts of salt water.
sore throat.description: Gargle with warm salt water and spit it out, if that helps.
sore throat.name: Warm salt water gargle

stomach upset.caution: Seek care if you cannot keep fluids down.
stomach upset.description: Eat small, plain meals if you feel able to eat, such as rice, toast, or plain crackers.
stomach upset.name: Small, plain meals

stomach upset.caution: Seek care for signs of dehydration, such as very little urine or dizziness.
stomach upset.description: Sip fluids little and often to stay hydrated.
stomach upset.name: Fluids little and often

tiredness.description: Keep regular sleep and wake times, and a dark, quiet bedroom where possible.
tiredness.name: Regular sleep routine

tiredness.description: A short walk in daylight can help daytime alertness.
tiredness.name: Daylight walk
